DIAGNOSIS READY: Stevens-Johnson Syndrome (SJS) / Toxic Epidermal Necrolysis (TEN).

The clinical presentation of coalescing erythematous macules, bullae, and desquamation on the upper back, combined with oropharyngeal ulcers, epidermal necrosis on biopsy, and normal blood counts, is classic for this severe cutaneous adverse reaction. Given the high mortality rate, immediate dermatology consultation and discontinuation of potential offending medications are critical.
